metadata.description: Official Voicenter Claude Code plugins — live MCP access, integration skills for Voicenter's REST and webhook APIs, and a bot-builder authoring pipeline

plugins.name: voicenter-mcp
plugins.description: Live access to all Voicenter APIs directly from Claude Code via the MCP server at mcp01.voicenter.co. Authenticated via OAuth — no manual token setup required.

plugins.name: voicenter-api
plugins.description: Integration skills for Voicenter's REST and webhook APIs: VoiceBot, Click2Call, Pop-Up Screen, CDR Notification, External Layer, Call Log, Blacklist, Mute Recording, Extension List, Real-Time, Productive Dialer, Login/Logout, Lead Tracker, Active Calls, CRM Onboarding, Get Call History.

plugins.name: voicenter-bot-builder
plugins.description: Three-skill pipeline for designing and generating Voicenter Bot JSON: Agent Spec Designer (interview), Intent Detail Author (per-intent language), JSON Assembler (wire-format projection). Produces a deployable bot-<name>-<date>.json.
